ठ: ठ The aspirate of the preceding letter, corresponding to Ṭh.
ठ m. (-ठः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The disk of the sun or moon. 3 A circle, a globe. 4 A cypher. 5 An object of sense. 6 A loud noise. 7 An idol, a deity.
ठक्कुर: ठक्कुर m. (-रः) An idol, a deity, an object of reverence or worship.
ठठम्: ठठम् ind. An imitative sound. ड
